eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 两行接入

headline.zh:
Agent 跑穷你之前
先跳闸
headline.en:
Trips before your Agent
burns your budget

sub.zh: 给单次任务设一个硬上限——下一次调用要把花费推过天花板时，在它发出之前就把循环掐断，钱根本没花出去。这是执行式熔断，不是事后画一张成本图。
sub.en: Set a hard ceiling on one task. When the next call would push spend past it, the loop is cut before the call ever goes out — the money is never spent. An enforcing fuse, not an after-the-fact cost chart.

title.en: Blocks the call before the money is spent

body.zh: 保险丝在调用发出之前估出这次的花费上界，一旦会把累计推过天花板就直接掐断——那次超预算的调用根本没发出去，钱也没花出去。不是事后报账。
body.en: Before a call goes out, the fuse estimates its upper-bound cost; the moment that would push the cumulative total past the ceiling, it cuts in — the over-budget call is never sent and the money is never spent. Not an after-the-fact report.

title.zh: 两行接入，现有代码不用改
title.en: Two lines, your existing code untouched

body.zh: 把 Agent 的主调用包进一个作用域，或装一次接管 LLM 入口——你已经在用的调用方式会被自动拦截计量，不用为每个 provider 改一遍代码。
body.en: Wrap your Agent's main call in one scope, or install once to take over the LLM entry point — the calls you already make get gated and metered automatically, no per-provider code rewrite.

body.zh: Agent 最常用的流式调用，过去会因为读不到用量而记成零花费、保险丝永远不跳。现在流一耗尽就按真实用量记账，拿不到用量就按调用前的保守上界记——累计熔断对流式照样生效。
body.en: The streaming calls agents actually use used to read as zero spend because usage arrived too late, so the fuse never tripped. Now each stream is metered on exhaustion — real usage when the provider emits it, else the conservative pre-call upper bound — so the cumulative fuse holds on streamed runs too.

body.zh: 保险丝跳闸时，会带着这次的花费、上限和触顶原因回调你注册的钩子——接进你的告警、审计或计数，不用在每个任务外面再包一层 try/except。回调出错也不会影响是否拦下调用。
body.en: When the fuse trips, it calls the hook you registered with the spend, ceiling, and which limit blew — wire it into your own alerting, audit log, or counter, without wrapping every task in its own try/except. A callback that errors never changes whether the call is blocked.

headline.zh: Agent 跑穷操作者的事，别再重演
headline.en: Don't let an Agent bankrupt its operator again

sub.zh: 一条 pip install，给你的下一个 Agent 装上保险丝。开源、Apache-2.0、永久免费。
sub.en: One pip install puts a fuse on your next Agent. Open source, Apache-2.0, free forever.

tag.zh: 给自主 Agent 装的执行式花费保险丝
tag.en: The enforcing spend fuse for autonomous Agents
